title: Mecox (Bridgehampton)
summary: Meacox is connected with a farming district and inland bay at Bridgehampton. The modern spelling Mecox remains attached to Mecox Bay and the surrounding Bridgehampton landscape.
translation_content:
An earlier interpretation read the name as a plain bare of timber, but the history later rejects that explanation. The preferred interpretation connects Mecox with Secommecock or Mecock, treating the placename as a possessive form linked to a Native person.

Why Place Names Matter

“Place names mark and define our landscapes, neighborhoods, and communities. They create a certain understanding of place.”

— City of Boulder, Boulder Park Name Histories (2020), project overview
whereintheworld_content: Map location note: the pin is placed near Mecox Bay in Bridgehampton to represent the farming district, plain, and inland bay association; it is not an exact historic boundary.
